item.title: About us
item.description: About us Mountain Technical Due Diligence Services are a small team of people who love software, technology, start-ups and investment. We’ve been on the receiving end of due diligences, both good and bad, and we’ve been on the other side as well. Technical due diligences are often sloppy, and this leads to poor risk assessment and valuation. This usually results in animosity when the cracks begin to show. We would much rather have both parties happy and productive after an investment.

item.title: Our process
item.description: Our process A due diligence may take from four to eight days or more to complete, depending on the selected service and availability of key people. Meet with you to learn about you, your goals, and the company in which you intend to invest. Establish contact with the company’s CTO or equivalent and explain the process. Prepare a detailed and tailored preliminary questionnaire, to be completed by the CTO, so we are prepared for the site visits.

item.title: Privacy policy
item.description: Privacy policy This site collects no data at all. It only makes use of Google Analytics to gain insights into the number of visitors and usage patterns.

The team Hedley Roos Founder Hedley has two decades experience in the software industry. He is one of the fortunate few who have managed to turn their passion into a career. Hedley has grown start-ups and built teams of engineers who have successfully migrated companies like Telkom and MTN onto modern bespoke software ecosystems. He is a prolific contributor to open source software. After serving as CTO for Praekelt Consulting for a number of years Hedley decided it was time to scale down and get back to the hard engineering problems.
